messages.content: Validate only the single check described. Judge meaning, not exact wording. Return one JSON object with boolean valid and string issue. Reject only when the described check clearly fails.

CHECK: LISTED STATE EFFECTS ONLY.
Every listed state effect must be visibly supported by CANDIDATE. Check only listed effects.
For set_item_state with value "equipped", the candidate must put the item into a worn, mounted, or ready-for-use equipment position; merely picking it up or holding it is not enough.

STATE EFFECTS IF VALID
[{"id":"E1","state_effects":[{"op":"set_item_state","entity":"lantern","owner":"Tess","value":"equipped"}]}]

CANDIDATE
Tess picks up the lantern and fastens it to the equipment hook on her belt, ready for use.
